title: First AI Game's Cover Art (Kebabstar)
author: Novel-Common9013
selftext:
[Kebabstar](https://partner.steamgames.com/apps/landing/2451190) is still under early access, you wouldn't believe that how this game will be evolved in development cycles.

It was the first game and please follow if you like AI Art!

Note: Everything is original and we used frontier models to create this amazing game.

Thank you for listening to us and we will start show-time after finishing our digital gaming store (Because Steam waited us for 63 days for no-reason on early-access release progress.)

comments.author: TypicalPay1655
comments.body:
„Everything’s original”

Yeah the creativity and the originality is the first thing that comes to my mind after seeing this, I’m sure no other game or artist ever thought of using this style

replies.author: Suspicious_Neck_4069
replies.body: You're being harsh! Did you at least check out the game's page (without using the link)? When I started the trailer, I actually thought it was the third trailer for GTA 6. Dozens of photorealistic characters animated to perfection, lots of pretty girls, and a story that looks really well-crafted. The developer describes it better than I can on their Steam page: "pushing the boundaries of game development... blah blah... cutting-edge technology... blah blah... This is the next evolution in gaming..."
